# Renderer-owned stylesheet fixture

The runtime, fixed CSS and minimal sanitized HTML in `bundle/` are generated by
PalomarSubmission b9b593cefdc30461ae9c807ff07c49a04b39e326, using
`RUNTIME_SANITIZER`, `VERSO_RUNTIME`, `RENDER_STYLES` and `static_html_sanitize`.
The source body is only `<p>CSS policy fixture</p>`, with no declarations.
Vendored CSS provenance and license notices are included in the stylesheet.

These are validator evidence, not production inputs. Tests recompute the
artifact manifest and content address after each mutation, so a corrupted
stylesheet cannot pass merely by updating its bundle hashes.
